faqItems.q: Why do I get phishing emails from my own organisation?
faqItems.a: They are safe training simulations. If you spot one, report it: you earn XP and your department climbs the league.

faqItems.q: What happens if I click a simulation link?
faqItems.a: Nothing bad. You see a short explanation and a training that closes the gap. Your risk score goes down when you finish it.

faqItems.q: Is my data sent to AI Sel?
faqItems.a: No. AI Sel only gets the lesson context and an anonymous ID; never your name, email or job title.

faqItems.q: How is my risk score calculated?
faqItems.a: From unfinished assigned training, simulation results, open risks and first-try answers. My security shows each part.

faqItems.q: Can I learn on my phone?
faqItems.a: Yes. Open the portal in your phone's browser and add it to the home screen.
